text:
Elena (CS): quick heads-up on BrightHarbor onboarding — we've seen repeated p99 latency spikes during their afternoon activation window (1.2k req/s burst). p50/p95 look fine but p99 jumps hurt perceived UX. Thinking proactive mitigation before demo next week.

Cheng (Infra): can you paste the trace/sample? if it's KV-cache churn or very long prefixes, we can route to a compact variant for that traffic slice.

Elena (CS): pasted a couple traces here, truncated: `trace://hb/2026-03-20/alpha` — samples show long historical context + some batched backfills. client uses streaming + a few function calls.

Andre (ML): quick ML note: for BrightHarbor workloads, a mixed-precision int8 profile (per-channel symmetric, bias-correction) on compact-v2 retained quality on our eval set (ROUGE/EM analogues within 0.7% avg) and dropped median latency ~28% in our lab. p99 improved too but depends on routing granularity.

Cheng (Infra): proposal: 1) enable prefix-aware routing rule that sends requests with long context (>1024 tokens) to compact-v2-int8, 2) keep default on base model for normals, 3) a canary at 5% traffic for 24h. snippet:
```
routing_policy:
  - match: "ctx.len > 1024 || has_tag(backfill)"
    route: "compact-v2-int8"
    canary: 0.05
    duration: 24h
  - default: "base-v1"
```

Cheng (Infra): we'll also enable KV prefix caching for session affinity to reduce cache churn. Ops-bot shows current autoscale headroom ~20% in region-us-west.

Sam (Account): FYI BrightHarbor renewal touch is in 6 weeks. if we do this proactively and share perf numbers, should help reduce churn risk. any downside to customer-facing demo?

Andre (ML): main risk is rare edge-case hallucination shifts on highly adversarial prompts. mitigation: run a focused eval suite from their production prompts in the canary, and enable immediate rollback on drift >1.5% on our eval metrics. I can run the eval and post results by EOD.

Katie (CS): I'll coordinate with BrightHarbor ENG to get a sanitized sample prompt set + opt-in for the 5% canary. scheduled check-in tomorrow 10am PT.

Elena (CS): action items: Andre run targeted eval (due EOD), Cheng create routing policy + canary in staging (done by tomorrow AM), Katie get sample prompts & customer sign-off, Sam to own renewal narrative showing perf delta. tagging owners: @Andre (ML) @Cheng (Infra) @Katie (CS)

ops-bot: deployment-check: staging cluster available, infra tickets #INF-4421 created for canary config.

Cheng (Infra): once Andre uploads eval matrix, I'll attach it to the canary config and set automated rollback on accuracy-regressions.

Elena (CS): perfect — goal is to show a reproducible ~25-30% latency reduction for the demo and reduce renewal friction. I'll follow up with a short summary we can share with the customer if numbers look good. :thumbsup:
